name: bst-cst
about: bst, with the Lean files, the README and the changelog merged by tools/merge-cst (Lean by its commands)
common: Each theorem of your task is stated in your file with `sorry` for its proof: prove it in place, replacing the `sorry`, and change no statement, no definition (`Bst/Tree.lean` stays as it is) and no other theorem's proof. A lemma more than one proof could use goes in `Bst/Lemmas.lean`, and only there; a lemma for your own theorems alone goes in your own file, above them. Use Lean 4's core library only: no Mathlib, no new dependency, and no `sorry`, `axiom`, `admit` or `native_decide` in what you leave. `lake build` builds everything and says which declarations still use `sorry`. In `README.md`, tick each theorem you proved (`- [ ]` to `- [x]` on its line), and in `CHANGELOG.md` add one line under "Unreleased" for each: `- Prove `NAME`.`
tasks: Prove `delete_bst`, in `Bst/Delete.lean`: deletion keeps a search tree a search tree, through `join` and `removeMin`.

Prove `mem_delete`, `treeSort_sorted` and `mem_treeSort`, in `Bst/Contents.lean`. They may use the theorems of the other files, which other developers are proving meanwhile: their statements will not change, and a proof that uses them is complete once theirs are.
